title: Nia's landing world
question: Nia is the face. OkVevo is quiet. Scroll tells the story, not stacked sections. Palette and Ubuntu are locked. Pick the world that carries them.

options.label: Lantern Lecture
options.lineage: Victorian magic-lantern lecture, charcoal hall, one flame
options.thesis: Nia is the plate on the lantern. Scroll changes the plate, never the room.
options.viewport: Dark hall. Huge Ubuntu You talk. on the left. Nia projected on the right as a lantern plate. Orange pill Work with Nia under the line. Nav is a thin sand-hairline bar.
options.risk: Reads costume-heritage if a serif or cream sneaks in. Ubuntu and Ember Noir are the bind.

raised.raise: Talk, plan, and deliver are one shared symbol set, three plates of the same lantern.
The arriving plate snaps the last one to the edge. No polite fade between beats.
Nia's silhouette stays attached while the projected lesson trades.
Unlit beats stay as ghost type. Absence is drawn, not deleted.

options.label: Lesson Reel
options.thesis: The page is one film. Nia stays pinned. Frames advance as you scroll.
options.viewport: Centered Nia cutout in a film gate. Headline You talk. Nia makes the lesson. sits above her. CTA under. Side type changes as frames click forward.
options.risk: This is the Wispr-shaped page the brief named, and the direction most AI landings want.

options.label: Ignited Word
options.lineage: Hand-bent neon circuit, one continuous glass stroke
options.thesis: You talk. is one glass tube. The orange discharge is Nia arriving.
options.viewport: Black field. One continuous Ubuntu script You talk. drawn as orange neon. Nia's face appears inside the bend. Work with Nia is a small sand ghost under the transformer.
options.case: Holds the dark-room identification of a single ignited word. Loses on showing a lesson being made.
options.risk: A neon sign can hide the teaching assistant behind a logo trick.

options.label: Live Specimen
options.lineage: Variable-font specimen, one letter morphing under the hand
options.thesis: Lecture thickens into lesson. The word is the product.
options.viewport: One giant Ubuntu word filling the fold. Scroll interpolates lecture into lesson. Nia's portrait is the counterform inside the letters. CTA is a small orange tick on the axis.
options.case: Holds product clarity: talk becoming a lesson is a continuous morph. Loses the person Nia as the face.
options.risk: A type demo can forget the teaching assistant.

options.label: Signed Plate
options.lineage: Toyism collective plate, shared symbols, invented signatures
options.thesis: Every beat is a signed plate from the same symbol kit.
options.viewport: Flat charcoal plate. Hard-edged Nia. Hovering talk/plan/deliver symbols. A small Nia mark in the corner.
options.case: Educators do not identify with a painter collective. Clarity of talk-to-lesson is weaker than a lantern plate.
options.kept: One shared symbol set reused as three plates.
options.risk: Reads as illustration-as-brand, not a teaching assistant.

options.label: Torn Splash
options.thesis: Each beat is a torn splash that slams the last one offstage.
options.viewport: Full-frame orange splash. Sheared Ubuntu You talk. Nia as a torn cutout. CTA punched from a starburst.
options.case: Identification fails for a calm teaching assistant. Smash energy hides the mechanism.
options.kept: Arriving beat snaps the previous one to the edge.
options.risk: Poster violence against a quiet product.

options.label: Shadow Trade
options.lineage: Moon-shadow bazaar, stories attached to silhouettes
options.thesis: Each lesson is a shadow you can trade, with its story still pinned to it.
options.viewport: A lane of lesson-shadows. Nia's silhouette tagged with a small origin ticket. CTA is the trade.
options.case: A bazaar of shadows is not how an educator starts a lesson.
options.kept: Nia's silhouette stays attached while the projection trades.
options.risk: Surreal commerce over a teaching job.

options.label: Ghost Cells
options.lineage: Seven-segment clocks, unlit cells designed too
options.thesis: Talk, plan, deliver light as segments. Unlit beats stay drawn.
options.viewport: Four giant orange segment-words. Unlit plates as faint chrome ghosts. Nia is the colon between them.
options.case: Alarm-clock identification is wrong for Nia. Instant swaps fight a lecture's pace.
options.kept: Unlit beats remain as ghost type.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Centered hero, sticky product, three beats, pricing, FAQ. Played straight on Ember Noir.
canonCard.viewport: Meet Nia. You talk. Nia makes the lesson. Cutout under the headline. Work with Nia visible. Then stacked proof.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI product page, on purpose.
